head: 4fa245d3187d1abda2269936773145551c0452a2
scope: Finance-owned posted supplier-bill void and native payable attachment binding. Matched supplier bills (Procurement/Commerce), expense claims (People Payroll) and the Finance company-workspace browser route remain cross-owner/open; Finance is not certified.

posted_void.native_path: void_supplier_bill now branches on the locked invoice status. A posted standalone payable calls void_posted_supplier_bill, which posts an exact reversing journal (debit/credit and base amounts swapped), marks the original journal reversed, advances the bill version, clears outstanding, and records the command receipt/audit/outbox in the same serializable Finance unit.
posted_void.independent_approver: The reversing approver must differ from the bill creator and the original poster (INDEPENDENT_APPROVER_REQUIRED).
posted_void.input: SupplierBillVoidInput accepts optional periodId, entryDate and memo; posted voids require an open period and entry date. Draft voids keep their existing shape.
posted_void.result: SupplierBillResult returns reversalJournalId for the posted void; the reversal journal uses source_type=invoice_reversal and source_id=bill id.
posted_void.replay: The same idempotency key replays the retained receipt and does not post a second reversal.

attachments.native_path: post_supplier_bill_with_evidence binds reviewed supplier_bill / bill_match_support / action / invoice-review attachment sets through the shared Records/Files evidence port in the posting transaction.
attachments.policy: policy_fact(supplier_bill, bill_match_support, action, 1); target_types=[supplier_bill]; contexts=[bill_match_support/action/invoice-review]; binding_type=finance_supplier_bill_post; binding_id=<bill>:<next version>.
attachments.fail_closed: Assemblies that do not mount the Files port keep the explicit SUPPLIER_BILL_EVIDENCE_UNSUPPORTED denial for nonempty sets; there is no TypeScript fallback.
attachments.replay: A replayed post returns the receipt before evidence preparation and does not rebind the set.

closed_in_this_bundle.frontend: InvoiceActions now shows a 'Void posted bill' form (reversal period, date, reason) for a posted standalone bill; the native supplier-bill client no longer rejects attachmentSetIds on post.

browser.detail: The launch succeeds (303 to /finance?company=acme-co, erpx_company_h001 and erpx_last_workspace set). A company Finance record URL requires the explicit ?company=acme-co query; without it holding-proxy rewrites the page to /product-entry. With the query, the invoice detail returns 403 with 'The original queued Work context changed' from the finance-product-presentation work-context assertion. The choose-work-role page for the same next path returns 'No current role and package can open this page.' The available development account therefore lacks a Finance role/package that can open this company-level invoice. No browser acceptance is claimed; granting that role or supplying a Finance-authorized development account is required.

remaining: Matched supplier bills (Procurement/Commerce) and expense claims (People Payroll) still keep their own owners; Finance does not write those sources.

The available development account has no Finance role/package that can open the company-level invoice detail; the chooser reports no current role and package. A Finance-authorized development account or a reviewed role grant is required before the payables browser journey can be verified.
Finance remains partial at 9/10 workflows and is not owner 6/41.
notes: No production, staging, deployment, schema deletion or destructive cleanup was performed.
